hardware.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (0x00002689) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

quietSameSceneShaderAB.method: Actual same full30-school source/reset60steps, paused fixed pose, original fragments, ABBA32frames/block +8 warmups, actual draw color+shadow; production source unchanged.

pixels.method: Same actual source-reset/60steps oblique runtime. All stage pixels except explicit UI overlay rectangles. No resizing, warping, alignment or image editing.

mathAndPixels.explanation: Controlled camera/source fields/actor poses are numerically identical across all twelve single/school cases. Original source GPU attributes, complete triangle tuples, image encodings and UVs are exact. Cached legacy rotations and instanced eye transforms have measured bounded Float32 arithmetic differences; images are not claimed bit-identical. Pixel comparison uses actual fixed-pose renders, no registration, editing or substitute imagery. Tiny localized raster differences pass the recorded baseline gates.

actualVisualReview.method: Actual frozen R07 screenshots inspected alongside measured R06 fixed-pose comparison; six sources visible with original silhouettes, source materials, eye apertures and scene. All twelve image pairs quantitatively compared. No new visible tear, disconnected layer, placeholder, missing fish or lost source detail found.

verifierCorrections.reason: QA read an ELEMENT buffer through ARRAY target. Corrected target, then independently repeated complete GPU readback and TF. Valid quiet AB timing retained separately.

QA bypassed Three VAO/program caches without resetting full renderer state, and used scheduler string entries as objects / zero-delta REST / incomplete synthetic mouse event. Corrected fixture, not production.
QA compared the complete backing buffer rather than the packed typed view byteOffset/byteLength; full Three resetState also replaced state-only reset. Final fresh six-source GPU proof passes.

limits: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage measures page renderer JS heap; it is not total Chrome process/worker/native/GPU memory. backingStorageSize is reported separately when available.

WebGL byte accounting counts explicit currently live buffer/texture/renderbuffer storage including mipmaps, without driver alignment, shader/program storage, implicit framebuffer or VRAM physical residency.
Instrumentation holds live resource handles until explicit delete; this is for deterministic allocation accounting and can inhibit automatic GC cleanup of forgotten resources.
Fixed-pose screenshots are internal actual 3D QA evidence, not user visual acceptance.

Measurements do not demonstrate universal 60 FPS: full-detail legacy school retains approximately 33.4 ms p95 on this machine. Quiet AB GPU medians are essentially equal, not evidence of a large legacy speedup.
R07 legacy shader A/B uses fixed full-detail scene and original fragment programs; repeated cached/baseline block medians do not show a stable regression.
Two native tuna mouth bindings remain supported. The other four sources retain HOLD / original mouth posture; no new unsupported jaw or gill animation is claimed.

Explicit GL storage counts preserve full source textures, including the high-memory original 4096-pixel tuna material. Memory gains concern representation, bounded active caches, detached contexts and eye allocation, not lower source fidelity.
Public HTTPS/version/resource browser promotion is the parent lane after local PASS; this report authorizes local promotion, not user visual acceptance.
